title: SAGE (Subjectivity-Aware Generation Estimator): A Linguistic Framework for AI-Generated Review Detection *
abstract: arXiv:2611.03060v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We propose a simple, linguistically motivated approach to detecting AI-generated peer reviews based on the inherently human trait of subjectivity. We capture subjectivity at two levels: the semantic level of evaluative language and modality and the pragmatic level of speech acts. Using features derived from speech act annotations and model-predicted subjectivity scores, we train a lightweight classifier that achieves an AUROC of 0.9566 with only these linguistic features. Combining its output with the state-of-the-art detector Sem-Detect raises the TPR at 1% FPR of Sem-Detect on the APRDB benchmark from 0.874 to 0.985, outperforming the current state of the art. Our results show that linguistic features of subjectivity provide an explainable source of information for detecting AI-generated peer reviews and can be readily integrated into existing detection methods. translated_title: SAGE（主观性感知生成估计器）：一种用于检测AI生成审稿的语言学框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种简单且具有语言学动机的方法，利用人类固有的主观性特质来检测AI生成的同行评审。我们在两个层面捕捉主观性：评价性语言与情态的语义层面，以及言语行为的语用层面。利用从言语行为标注和模型预测的主观性分数中提取的特征，我们训练了一个轻量级分类器，仅凭这些语言学特征即可达到0.9566的AUROC。将其输出与最先进的检测器Sem-Detect相结合后，Sem-Detect在APRDB基准上1%假阳性率下的真阳性率（TPR）从0.874提升至0.985，超越了当前的最先进水平。我们的结果表明，主观性的语言学特征为检测AI生成的同行评审提供了一种可解释的信息来源，并且可以轻松地集成到现有的检测方法中。相关代码和模型已在GitHub上公开提供（https://github.com/A
tldr: 本文提出基于主观性语言学特征（评价性语言、情态和言语行为）的轻量级检测器SAGE，与Sem-Detect结合后将AI生成审稿检测在APRDB基准上1%假阳性率下的真阳性率从0.874提升至0.985，且具有可解释性。
en_tdlr: SAGE, a lightweight classifier leveraging linguistic features of subjectivity (evaluative language, modality, and speech acts), provides an explainable signal that boosts Sem-Detect's TPR at 1% FPR from 0.874 to 0.985 on the APRDB benchmark for AI-generated review detection.
